detail: books/profile-limits.lisp:65-66 describes the :max-connections default 32 as "fn.toml's [server] max_connections when it names none". books/native-config.lisp fn-ncfg-tablep/key-allowedp has no [server] table and no max_connections key (tables: store listener auth posting anchor acl2 log control alerts ops web resources tls); a config with `[server]\nmax_connections = 128` makes `operator init` exit 5 with 'usage operator request (CONFIGURATION SYNTAX)' (persvati, C3 developer image dev 0b4d3b183, 2026-10-07). The cap is changed by `fn operator CONFIG policy set exposure-connections N` (docs/operator.md:580), which the load harness uses (accepted on a loopback owner; R64 readers then held 65 connections). Fix: correct the comment, or add the key to the grammar if a config-time cap is wanted. Owner C (config).
title: fn.toml has no max_connections key: books/profile-limits.lisp:65 says it does (stale comment) and [server] makes `operator init` exit 5
